full_judgment: 4. The petitioners further case is that an oral agreement was concluded between the parties on 1-9-1999 that the lease period would be extended for a further period of 3 years. Though the period of oral lease was extended for a further period of 3 years, the respondent No. 4 started non-cooperation with the petitioner No. 2 and tried, on several occasions, to disturb the petitioners peaceful possession of the house for which the petitioners had to file Title Suit No. 193 of 1999 seeking a decree of permanent injunction restraining the respondents from disturbing the petitioners possession. The petitioners offered rent to the respondent No. 4 but it was refused and they in order to avoid for their being treated as defaulters, sent monthly rent to the respondent No.4 by money order but the same was returned unserved. The petitioners then filed House Rent Control Case No. 10 of 1999 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Dhaka and obtained an order to allow the petitioner No.2 to deposit the rent to the Rent Controller and he has been depositing the rent.
